name: Rose Medical
old_description: Rose Medical specializes in crafting high-quality cannulas, catheters, and custom medical devices, offering a comprehensive range of manufacturing capabilities:
about:
Rose Medical is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The company was founded in 1998 as Rose Technologies, initially focusing on manufacturing and quality‑assurance testing equipment for medical devices.

Today Rose Medical operates as a full‑service medical device contract manufacturer specializing in catheters and finished devices. Its in‑house capabilities span tip forming, catheter lamination, wire‑reinforced cannula production, balloon forming, injection molding, laser processing, PTFE forming, silicone molding, dip molding, assembly, and sterile barrier packaging. The company runs multiple ISO Class 7 cleanrooms at its Grand Rapids site and opened a second manufacturing location in 2024 to add injection molding, laser processing, and other value‑added processes. An internal CNC machine shop supports custom automation equipment.

Rose Medical serves the cardiovascular, neurovascular, robotic surgery, gastrointestinal, and minimally invasive surgery markets. Its customer base includes major original equipment manufacturers as well as tier 2 and tier 3 suppliers.

The company emphasizes vertical integration to deliver speed to market, seamless communication through a dedicated project engineer from design for manufacture through validation, and guaranteed consistency via a quality culture that cross‑trains all employees on critical quality principles.

name: Rosti North Carolina
old_description: Partner in Precision Plastic Injection Moulding and Contract Manufacturing
about:
Rosti North Carolina operates as part of the Rosti Group, a global contract manufacturer specializing in precision plastic injection moulding. The group was founded in 1944 and maintains 13 manufacturing sites across Europe, Asia, and North America. The Cary, North Carolina facility serves as a North American hub within this network.

The company provides end-to-end production solutions, including plastic injection moulding, multi-material moulding, high-volume production, and cleanroom manufacturing in ISO-classified environments. Its capabilities extend to automation and assembly with robotic handling, automated inspection, and multi-step component integration, as well as toolmaking, engineering, and industrialisation services such as tool design, rapid sampling, pilot production, and global production transfer. The group emphasizes sustainable manufacturing, targeting 100 percent clean energy across all sites and a 50 percent energy efficiency improvement by 2040.

Rosti serves OEMs in medical and life sciences, automotive and e-mobility, consumer and home appliances, industrial and professional equipment, and filtration, optics, and high-performance components. Medical device, pharmaceutical, and diagnostic customers rely on its documented and validated quality workflows in cleanroom settings.

The company positions itself as a technical partner across the full product lifecycle, blending over 80 years of manufacturing heritage with a global footprint and a commitment to sustainability. Its five-stage manufacturing journey — consult and design support, prototype and validate, industrialise and optimise, scale and transfer, produce, assemble, and deliver — is designed to provide clarity, precision, and customer partnership.

name: Roy's Wood Products
old_description: We provide a full line of wood products and the industry’s best hardware and accessories: from custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts to dovetail drawer boxes, face frame material, hardwood plywood and mouldings, dimensional lumber, shutters, & more.
about:
Roy's Wood Products was founded in 1962 in Lugoff, South Carolina, when Roy Brazell Sr. began crafting cabinet doors in a garage shop. The business remained family-owned through three generations: Roy Jr. purchased the operation in 1985 and expanded it to 15,000 square feet, and in 2008 his sons Jody and Russell Brazell took ownership. The company was renamed Roy's Wood Products, Inc. in 2000 to reflect its broadening product lines.

Today the company operates over 61,000 square feet of factory space that includes a rough mill and a dedicated cabinet door manufacturing facility. It produces a full line of stock and custom wood products: custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts, dovetail drawer boxes, face frame material, hardwood plywood, mouldings, dimensional lumber, shutters, and a range of hardware and accessories.

The primary customers are cabinet shops, woodworking professionals, and contractors who need reliable millwork and components for residential and commercial cabinetry. The company's showroom in Lugoff serves as a walk-in resource for builders and designers selecting materials and hardware.

Roy's Wood Products emphasizes an old-fashioned focus on excellence at a reasonable price, backed by experienced craftsmen and modern tooling. The Brazell family's hands-on leadership and six-decade track record are cited as the foundation for consistent quality and service.

name: Ruben Custom Sawmill and Woodworks, LLC
old_description: Founded by Matt Ruben in 2018, Ruben Custom Sawmill began with a single sawmill and a bold vision: reclaim Minnesota's fallen trees and turn them into lasting works of art. What started as a weekend passion is now a full-time, family-run business trusted by clients across the Twin Cities.
about:
Ruben Custom Sawmill and Woodworks, LLC is based in White Bear Township, Minnesota. The company was founded in 2018 by Matt Ruben, who started with a single portable sawmill and a vision to reclaim fallen Minnesota trees. What began as a weekend passion project has grown into a full-time, family-run operation serving clients throughout the Twin Cities metro area.

The business focuses on three core areas: custom furniture such as live-edge tables, bar tops, and mantles; premium walnut countertops built in a butcher-block style; and portable milling services that bring a Wood-Mizer sawmill directly to a client's property to process logs into kiln-dried slabs and native hardwood lumber. The shop also maintains an inventory of kiln-dried slabs available by appointment. Since inception, the team reports salvaging over 1,000 trees and completing more than 1,000 client projects.

Customers range from homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind dining tables or mantels to DIY woodworkers purchasing slabs for their own projects, as well as landowners who want logs milled on-site for future interior work. Testimonials on the company's site highlight residential clients in the Twin Cities area who have commissioned custom furniture, countertops, and on-site milling of cherry and burr oak logs.

Ruben states that the company was started to give fallen trees a second life and to preserve the stories embedded in each slab, turning what would be waste into lasting functional art. The founder emphasizes care, craftsmanship, and character in every job, whether milling on a client's land or building a custom piece in the shop.

about:
Rustic Log Furniture of Utah, Inc. operates from Orem, Utah. The company traces its roots to the summer of 1997 when Randy Jackson began producing log porch swings with the goal of shipping them nationwide. In early 1998 his brother Rodney joined the venture, and the product line quickly expanded beyond swings to include beds, dressers, dining tables, chairs, and a growing catalog of cabin-style furnishings. The business remains family-owned, now run by the Jackson family.

In addition to solid-wood pieces, the company produces complementary lines such as bedding, metal works, wood carvings and burnings, photography, and metal and antler chandeliers. Production includes custom orders for both residential and commercial clients.

Rustic Log Furniture serves customers across all 50 states, parts of Canada, and Europe. Its pieces have furnished professional establishments including the Cedar Hills Community Center in Utah and Marriott vacation properties in Park City and South Lake Tahoe. The entertainment industry has also sourced products for Warner Bros.’ film Unaccompanied Minors, Paramount’s series Yellowstone, and stage productions at the Hale Center Theater in Orem.

The company emphasizes unique designs, continuous product improvement, and competitive pricing, but cites personalized, honest customer service and a commitment to environmental responsibility as its core differentiators. The founders frame the business as a long-term relationship built on trust rather than short-term transactions.
